current.text: DeRozan joined Denver this offseason. Peyton Watson left the team.
Denver's projected starters are Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, Cam Johnson, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokic. DeRozan is projected as the first player off the bench.
Experts expect fewer minutes and less usage than last season. He is likely in a lower-minute bench role, with worry about how his minutes fit with Jokic's, on a more talented team.
Upside case: one injury to Braun or Johnson could push him to about 32 minutes, 19 points and five assists.
Denver may trade Cam Johnson or Christian Braun. One expert expects at least two of last year's starters, including Johnson, to be gone by the deadline. That would open a bigger role for DeRozan.
Even off the bench he should still score and help FT%. He is a tier 8 small forward.

Fair value is around rank 135 to 140, and taking him there is a good pick. He is not a top 100 player. Avoid him at ESPN's top-100 ranks and ADP (55 to 87). Yahoo's earlier rank of 251 was far too low.
In an auction mock he went for 3 USD, but the expert values him at 1 USD.
Denver has a good schedule: 43 games through March 28 and only 14 back-to-backs, one of the lowest counts in the league. The team also has one of only three five-game weeks this season.
Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest.
One expert projects Denver for about 50 wins.

durable.text: He is a great scorer, but his team must make room for him on offense and defense. He has spacing and defensive limitations.
His category profile: strong FT% and few turnovers. He makes few threes and grabs few rebounds for a forward.

note: Experts put his fair value around rank 135 to 140, which is the edge of our 144-player pool. That makes him a 1 to 3 USD bench pick (Yahoo value 5 USD, ESPN 2 USD), well below the 10 USD he cost in our league last season. He fits punt 3PM and punt REB builds, where his FT% (86.0% on about 5 attempts), low turnovers and points help most. Early in the season, check whether his bench minutes stay near the projected 29 or drop lower, and watch for a Braun or Johnson injury or trade that would give him a starting role.
